svg.title: Anzen monthly allowance ladder
svg.desc: One confirmed rollover creates twelve allowance months, each its own 0.1 bitcoin coin with its own unlock date about 30 days apart. The phone alone can claim a month after its date, the phone can return unused months to the vault, and the hardware wallet alone can pull any month back at any time. None of these spends is presigned.
svg.text: one yearly rollover creates twelve dated coins; each month opens on its own date, whenever earlier months were used
month i unlocks at the ladder start + i × 2,592,256 s (~30 days); the date is enforced by consensus
nothing per month is presigned; each spend pays that day's fee rate
phone alone after Tᵢ · HWW alone at any time
with --limit, the rest of the month goes back to the vault in the same transaction
once the next month has unlocked; --all also returns the current month
destination shown on the HWW, normally the vault
every month, locked or not; also cancels emergency access
